# Bash buildout rules (plugin) — run ONCE during repo creation, then discarded.
# One-time structural checks that the shell quality gates and target shell were
# decided; the ongoing shell judgment rules live in languages/bash.llmlint.yml.
version: 1.1

rules:
  - name: shell_quality_gated
    description: |
      true when both `shellcheck` and `shfmt` run in the gate for every shell
      project and fail on issues (no warnings backlog) — as each project's
      `lint` and `format` targets, reached by root recipes that delegate to the
      orchestrator. false when either is absent from `just check`/CI, is run
      advisory-only, or covers only some projects because the root recipe
      hand-rolls the list — so a lint or format drift never blocks a merge.
    files:
      include:
        - "justfile"
        - "Justfile"
        - ".justfile"
        - ".github/workflows/**"
        - "nx.json"
        - "**/project.json"

  - name: target_shell_chosen
    description: |
      true when the target shell is an explicit decision — POSIX `sh` (no bashisms)
      or `bash` — declared via a consistent shebang and stated in AGENTS.md, with
      the CI matrix matching. false when scripts mix `sh` and `bash` shebangs with
      no stated target, so portability is accidental rather than decided.
    files:
      include: ["**/*.sh", "bin/**", "**/AGENTS.md"]
    relevance: the target files are shell scripts or record the shell decision

  - name: shell_coverage_merged_and_gated
    description: |
      true when the coverage bar is still enforced with the `bats` suite spread
      across projects: each project's `test` target writes `kcov`/`bashcov` data
      into its declared target outputs, and a repo-level `coverage` target
      depending on every `test` merges them (`kcov --merge`, or SimpleCov's
      result merging) and fails below the bar — reading the merged line rate
      itself, since `kcov` has no fail-under flag. false when the projects' data
      is merged but nothing thresholds it, when only one project's coverage is
      measured, or when the bar was dropped rather than documented in AGENTS.md
      with a reason and still enforced at the lower value.
    files:
      include:
        - "**/project.json"
        - "nx.json"
        - "justfile"
        - "Justfile"
        - ".justfile"
        - "**/AGENTS.md"
        - ".github/workflows/**"
